we have developed a new QoS-based multicast routing algorithm that can be used to distribute layered video in rate-based networks with a large number of heterogeneous receivers.
we have developed a multicast routing protocol that can be applied to rate-based networks and is able to support heterogeneous QoS requirements of layered multicast video.
